verses.text: After saying these things, Jesus looked up to heaven and prayed, “Father, the time has come. Glorify your Son so the Son may glorify you.
You gave him authority over all people, so he can give eternal life to everyone you’ve given him.
And this is eternal life: that they know you, the only true God, and Jesus Christ, the one you sent.
I glorified you here on earth by finishing the work you gave me to do.
Now, Father, glorify me in your presence with the glory I had with you before the world began.
“I have made your name known to the people you gave me from the world. They belonged to you, and you gave them to me. They’ve kept your word.
Now they know that everything you gave me comes from you.
I gave them the words you gave me. They accepted them and truly understood that I came from you. They believed you sent me.
I’m praying for them. I’m not praying for the world, but for those you gave me, because they belong to you.
Everything that belongs to me belongs to you, and everything that belongs to you belongs to me. I’m glorified through them.
“I’m no longer in the world, but they’re still in the world while I’m coming to you. Holy Father, protect them by your name—the name you gave me—so they may be one, just as we are one.
While I was with them, I protected them by your name, the name you gave me. I guarded them, and none was lost except the one doomed to destruction, so Scripture would be fulfilled.
Now I’m coming to you. I’m saying these things while I’m still in the world so they may have my joy made complete in themselves.
I’ve given them your word, and the world has hated them because they don’t belong to the world, just as I don’t belong to the world.
I’m not asking you to take them out of the world, but to protect them from the evil one.
They don’t belong to the world, just as I don’t belong to the world.
Set them apart by the truth. Your word is truth.
Just as you sent me into the world, I’ve sent them into the world.
For their sake, I set myself apart, so they too may truly be set apart.
“I’m not praying only for these disciples. I’m also praying for those who will believe in me because of their message,
so they may all be one. Father, just as you are in me and I am in you, may they also be in us, so the world may believe you sent me.
I’ve given them the glory you gave me, so they may be one just as we are one—
I in them and you in me—so they may be completely united. Then the world will know you sent me and loved them just as you loved me.
“Father, I want those you gave me to be with me where I am, so they can see the glory you gave me, because you loved me before the world was created.
Righteous Father, the world hasn’t known you, but I know you. These disciples know you sent me.
I’ve made your name known to them, and I’ll keep making it known, so the love you have for me may be in them, and I may be in them.”
